g.text: From "Hello" to "Bye": a code change and an infra change, each through its own pipeline
<name> = your short name (robi) · <gh> = your GitHub user · steps below
Once, by hand: terraform apply in bootstrap/ (ECR, S3 bucket, IAM role),
docker push :1.0.0, terraform apply in infra-code/, set the repo variables
Terminal: kubectl get pods -l app=hello -w, leave it open
service-code, new branch: Hello → Bye in app.py and test_app.py,
Pull request: pr.yml runs unittest and docker build (no push).
Push to main: main.yml runs unittest, reads the version (uv version --short),
assumes the role via OIDC, builds and pushes hello:1.1.0 to ECR
infra-code, new branch: image tag 1.0.0 → 1.1.0 in k8s/deployment.yaml
Pull request: pr.yml runs fmt -check, init, validate, plan.
The plan shows one change: the image. You merge
Push to main: main.yml runs the same, then apply, no approval.
Terminal: a new Pod with 1.1.0, ready, an old one goes; three times.
